nodes.label: Design System: Precision Industrial / Dispatcher Console
Color Palette: Warm Neutrals + Clay Accent + Semantic State Colors
nodes.rationale: Shifted away from cobalt-on-slate (read as generic-SaaS or SRE). Warm tinted neutrals hue 60-80 with clay accent at hue 38. State hues 25/82/150/230/295 spaced to survive colorblind grayscale. OKLCH throughout for perceptual uniformity.

nodes.label: Semantic State Color Pairs (enum-to-swatch mapping)
nodes.rationale: Same enum value always uses the same bg+fg pair across every surface. State-Is-Sacred rule: edit styles.css, never inline a one-off. Pairs: warn-amber REQUESTED/RESERVED, violet QUOTED, moss APPROVED/IN_PROGRESS, sky DISPATCHED/IDLE, neutral COMPLETED, brick CANCELLED.

nodes.label: Typography: Single System Sans Stack + Mono for Codes
nodes.rationale: One-Family Rule: no display face, hierarchy via weight (400/500/600) and scale. Mono stack reserved as vocabulary signal for serial numbers, VMRS codes, IDs, timestamps — not decorative.

nodes.label: Elevation: Flat by Default (single modal lift only)
nodes.rationale: Flat-By-Default Rule. Only the modal sheet gets a box-shadow. Cards, panels, drawers separated by 1px hairline borders. Hover communicated by background tint not elevation.

nodes.label: Component Library: Buttons, Chips, Badges, Panels, Tables, Dispatch Timeline
Dispatch Timeline Component (.timeline)
nodes.rationale: State-driven event backgrounds via semantic pairs. Absence events at 0.78 opacity with 135deg repeating linear gradient so they read as unavailable. Today marker clay-soft tint. RBC content uses minmax(0,1fr) to prevent viewport overflow.
